name: 3D Gaussian Smoothing
aliases: 9-tap Gaussian smoothing (binomial filter via bilinear sampling)
definition: A smoothing kernel that convolves a pixel with a 3D Gaussian distribution. Weights follow a Gaussian distribution rather than being uniform as in box smoothing.
summary: 3D Gaussian Smoothing is a voxelization post-processing technique that reduces noise and provides smoother transitions than box filters by convolving a spectral cube with a 3D Gaussian distribution using a binomial approximation via bilinear texture sampling.
